title: Lesson 16 · A polite request
titleZh: 第16课 彬彬有礼的要求

examples.en: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon find it.
examples.zh: 如果你把汽车停在了错误的地方，交通警察很快就会发现。

examples.en: A traffic policeman will soon find it.

examples.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
examples.zh: 如果他没给你罚款单就放你走了，算你走运。

examples.en: I found this note on my car.
examples.zh: 我在我的车上发现了这样一张字条。

examples.en: This is a No Parking area.

examples.zh: 如果您对我们街上的标牌稍加注意，您在此会过得很愉快的。

examples.en: This note is only a reminder.

article.en: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon find it.
article.zh: 如果你把汽车停在了错误的地方，交通警察很快就会发现。

article.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
article.zh: 如果他没给你罚款单就放你走了，算你走运。

article.en: However, this does not always happen.
article.zh: 然而，情况并不总是这样。

article.en: Traffic police are sometimes very polite.
article.zh: 交通警察有时也很客气。

article.en: During a holiday in Sweden, I found this note on my car.
article.zh: 在瑞典度假期间，我在我的车上发现了这样一张字条。

article.en: It read, 'Sir, we welcome you to our city.'
article.zh: 字条上写着：“先生，欢迎您光临我们的城市。”

article.en: 'You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs.'
article.zh: “如果您对我们街上的标牌稍加注意，您在此会过得很愉快的。”

article.en: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
article.zh: 如果你收到这样的恳求，你是不会不遵照执行的！
